sql:
SELECT
    c.ProductCategoryName,
    count() AS product_count
FROM retail.DimProduct p
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory s
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory c
    ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY c.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY c.ProductCategoryName
